ABOUT.LABEL: WHO'S NAM?
ABOUT.TITLE: About me
ABOUT.TEXT_1: Hey, I'm Nam. I build complete web applications — from the Angular frontend through the Django REST API to the Docker deployment on my own server. Coding clicked for me the first time I watched someone breeze through an interface I'd built — these days I make sure everything behind it runs just as smoothly. I believe great software is invisible: when the user never has to stop and think, the problem is truly solved.
ABOUT.TEXT_2: I take ownership from the first problem to the shipped solution, and I set the bar a little higher every time. Give me a hard challenge and a clear vision, and I'll help turn it into something real.

SKILLS.LABEL: MY STACK
SKILLS.TITLE: Skill set
SKILLS.DESCRIPTION: I've put these technologies to work on real projects, and I push each one further with every build. I don't just use a tool, I learn how it works under the hood so I can ship solutions that are fast, reliable, and built to scale.
SKILLS.BADGE: Also, I'm interested in diving into:

PROJECTS.LABEL: MY CRAFT
PROJECTS.TITLE: Projects
PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Each of these started as a real problem to solve. I made the tough calls, shipped solutions I'm proud of, and leveled up with every one. Explore them live and dig into the code to see how.

VIDEOFLIX.TITLE: Videoflix
VIDEOFLIX.TECH: Python | Django REST | Redis | FFmpeg | Docker
VIDEOFLIX.DESCRIPTION: A Netflix-style video streaming platform. Register, sign in and watch videos as adaptive HLS streams (480p/720p/1080p) — uploaded videos are transcoded automatically in the background.
VIDEOFLIX.IMPLEMENTATION: Complete Django REST backend: authentication with JWTs in HttpOnly cookies including email activation and password reset, video upload with FFmpeg transcoding into three resolutions via a Redis/RQ task queue, and delivery as HLS segments. Runs in production in Docker behind a reverse proxy on my own server — backend and deployment are entirely my own work.

CODERR.TITLE: Coderr
CODERR.TECH: Python | Django REST | Token Auth | Docker
CODERR.DESCRIPTION: A Fiverr-style service marketplace: business users create offers in three package tiers, customers order and review — with profiles, filters and order management.
CODERR.IMPLEMENTATION: A full DRF API built from six Django apps: token authentication, role-based permissions (business/customer), nested serializers, filtering, pagination and DB annotations for sorting. Orders snapshot the offer conditions at purchase time. Backed by 73 tests at 99% coverage. The frontend was provided as a course template — the entire API is my own work.

QUIZLY.TITLE: Quizly
QUIZLY.TECH: Python | Django REST | Whisper | Gemini | Docker
QUIZLY.DESCRIPTION: Turns any YouTube video into a multiple-choice quiz: submit a URL, and the AI pipeline transcribes the audio with Whisper and generates a ten-question quiz with Google Gemini.
QUIZLY.IMPLEMENTATION: Django REST backend with a complete AI pipeline: audio download, Whisper transcription and Gemini quiz generation. Authentication uses JWTs in HttpOnly cookies with refresh token rotation and blacklisting. The static frontend was provided as a course template — backend, AI integration and Docker deployment are my own work.

JOIN.TITLE: Join
JOIN.DESCRIPTION: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.
JOIN.IMPLEMENTATION: As the team's frontend developer, I designed and built the user interactions and kept the app fully responsive, owning the frontend independently at every stage.

POLLO.TITLE: El Pollo Loco
POLLO.DESCRIPTION: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.
POLLO.IMPLEMENTATION: Built entirely from scratch using vanilla JavaScript and object-oriented programming. Implemented game physics, collision detection, and sprite animations while managing game state and user input.

POKEDEX.TITLE: Pokédex Holo TCG
POKEDEX.DESCRIPTION: A from-scratch rebuild of a Pokédex that shows all 1025 Pokémon from the PokéAPI as holographic trading cards. Opening one reveals a mouse-tilting 3D card in TCG style. It's fully bilingual (EN/DE), with translated names, types and abilities, plus search, filters, evolution chains and a compare mode.
POKEDEX.IMPLEMENTATION: A remake of an earlier vanilla project as a modern Next.js app. The first page is server-rendered, then the client takes over search, type/generation/favorite filters and a URL-driven detail dialog. The 3D card is built with Three.js / React Three Fiber (a drawn canvas texture plus a holographic sheen). Full EN/DE localization via bundled name/ability data, plus a low-graphics mode (pixel sprites) for weaker devices and bulk loading. Shipped as a static export (no server required), with PWA/offline caching, a sitemap, and unit (Vitest) + end-to-end (Playwright) tests.
